text:
Emma (Marketing): Quick sync — we need final signoff on the Kestrel case quote set for social + a 30s testimonial clip. Target region: APAC (AU/SG). Can we land this by EOD tomorrow?
Ryan (Growth): copying the clip specs: 30s, 1080p, subtitles burned in for en/zh. Do we have localization notes from the customer?
Sarah (CS): Customer gave a short variant for APAC, but it needs tone smoothing. I can edit for clarity. Need legal to confirm we can publish non-redacted quote.
Jules (Legal): I pulled the release and there's PII in the second paragraph. We need the customer to sign the simplified release or we redact. Suggest this text for redaction: "customer account id" and the street address line.
Emma (Marketing): OK, can we try to avoid heavy redaction — it hurts the soundbite. Sarah, can you push a cleaned copy to the customer asking them to initial the simplified release? I'll call them if needed.
Sarah (CS): On it. I'll send the cleaned quote + a one-click approve link. ETA 2 hours.
Ryan (Growth): Once approved, OpsBot can create the SFDC campaign and tag inbound leads to the Kestrel launch flow. OpsBot, can you pre-create the campaign template?
OpsBot: created draft campaign: "Kestrel_APAC_CaseLaunch_2026". Placeholder fields: source=webinar, tag=case_kestrel, owner=unassigned. Use /ops finalize to create live campaign.
Emma (Marketing): Nice. Also we need a short embargo window: publish 2026-04-14 08:00 AEST, embargo until 07:00 UTC same day. Jules, does that timeline give legal enough review time?
Jules (Legal): That works if we have the signed release within 24 hours. If not, we must publish a redacted version or delay.
Sarah (CS): Sent approval request to the customer, subject: "Quick sign: Kestrel customer story — 1-click". Pinged them on email + slack.
Emma (Marketing): FYI creative brief for the clip — keep opening 5s logo splash, 20s quote highlight, 5s CTA. Subtitles: ENG + ZH (burned), and include lower-third: "Kestrel — Head of Ops, Mei Chen".
Ryan (Growth): Small ask: can we get a 15s cut for paid ads? If so, mark deliverable in the checklist.
Emma (Marketing): Yes — add 15s ad cut. Sarah, once release is signed, please drop final text in this thread and OpsBot will run the publish checklist.
Sarah (CS): Customer signed the simplified release — uploading final quote below.
Sarah (CS): "We migrated to Redwood Dedicated and saw a 45% drop in inference costs while improving 99th percentile latency by 30% — Mei, Head of Ops, Kestrel."
Jules (Legal): Approved language ok. No PII remaining. :thumbsup:
Emma (Marketing): Perfect. Ryan — can you confirm ad budget owner and scheduled boost window?
Ryan (Growth): Budget owner is growth@redwood.com, scheduled boost 4/14–4/21. I'll attach the UTM template.
Emma (Marketing): OpsBot — go live checklist please. Include items: render master clip, export 30s + 15s, burn subs EN/ZH, upload to CDN, create SFDC campaign, set Google/Meta ad tags, schedule blog post, schedule tweet + linkedin posts, set embargo. Paste checklist snippet below.
OpsBot: 
```
- Render master: master_kestrel_v1.mov
- Export: kestrel_30s.mp4, kestrel_15s.mp4
- Subtitles: en.srt, zh.srt (burned copies required)
- CDN upload: s3://redwood-marketing/kestrel/
- SFDC campaign: Kestrel_APAC_CaseLaunch_2026 (finalize)
- Blog: /content/case-studies/kestrel
- Social: twitter, linkedin, x-refs
- Ad tags: UTM params + campaign tag
- Publish time: 2026-04-14T07:00:00Z (remove embargo at 07:00Z)
```
Emma (Marketing): Thanks. I'll allocate a 1-hour pre-publish review slot 4/14 06:00Z for final checks. Everyone please mark calendar.
Ryan (Growth): Marked.
Sarah (CS): Marked and I'll monitor customer Slack during publish window.
Jules (Legal): I'll be on standby for any last-minute legal flags.
Emma (Marketing): Great team. Closing thread — please post final confirmations here once tasks are done. :rocket:
